description: Sophia Script for Windows (Windows 10, PowerShell 7). The most advanced PowerShell module on GitHub for fine-tuning Windows and automating routine tasks.
notes: This package provides Sophia Script for Windows 10, PowerShell 7 only.
Other editions: sophia-script, sophia-script-ps7, sophia-script-ltsc2024, sophia-script-ltsc2024-ps7, sophia-script-win10, sophia-script-ltsc2019, sophia-script-ltsc2021.
The Sophia and SophiaScript commands start a launcher. It runs Sophia.ps1 in PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe) from any shell (PowerShell 5.1, PowerShell 7 or CMD).
Sophia.ps1 is the preset. Your function selections in it are not kept on update. Keep your own copy of the edited file and use it after each update.
pre_install: abort "This package is for Windows 10, PowerShell 7. Detected: $ProductName (build $Build). Run 'scoop search sophia-script' to pick the right edition."
if (-not $PwshCommand) { warn 'This edition runs on PowerShell 7 only. Install it: scoop install main/pwsh' }
